title: After proven sync: how TermAl's cross-host work and procedures change now (Greg + Kimi)
acceptance: Kimi's read-only assessment is recorded on this item. It covers: safe to apply now / stop doing / current limits (manual export-git-import, local changes, local claims, evidence and verification records) / waits for one command. Each point cites its source (docs/features/git-task-sync.md, a trial note or a mailbox).
Both coordinators agree on a minimal action list with an owner per action, adding no new gate. A short Polish report reaches Greg via Engram::Asistant.
